## Professional Summary

Web and SaaS developer building websites, SaaS products and MVPs with AI in the loop, full-stack
from design through to deployment. Nine years of production software: roughly four years hands-on
engineering (Java/JEE, Spring, Node.js, TypeScript, Angular, iOS) and five leading delivery for
distributed enterprise teams across telecom, automotive, life sciences and retail.

The two halves work together. AI in the build loop compresses timelines from months to weeks, and
nine years inside enterprise codebases and delivery programmes is what keeps the architecture, tests
and data model sound enough to survive real users. Certified in Scrum and SAFe.

## Services

Primary offers:

- **Websites that rank and convert**: marketing sites, landing pages and portfolios designed and
  built from scratch. Structured data, clean semantics, proper meta tags and a sitemap go in during
  the build, with Core Web Vitals measured before launch.
- **SaaS & MVP builds**: the smallest version that proves the idea, covering auth, data model, core
  flows and payments if needed, deployed on infrastructure that can take growth.

Also available, as standalone or follow-on engagements:

- **Architecture & technical rescue**: for products that shipped fast and now can't move. Codebase
  audit, a clear view of what's worth keeping, an ordered refactor plan, or the work itself.
- **AI-augmented automation**: LLM workflows, agents, retrieval over internal documents, and
  integrations between systems that were never designed to talk, timed against the old baseline.

## How Engagements Run

1. **Scope** (free, ~1 week): a call, then a written scope covering what gets built, what doesn't,
   what it costs, and when it lands. Includes an "I'm not the right fit" if that's the answer.
2. **Build** (2 to 6 weeks typical): a working link in the first week, a demo every week, direct
   access, and an architecture review at the end of each week.
3. **Ship** (days): live on the client's own infrastructure, domain and accounts, with performance,
   accessibility and SEO checked before launch.
4. **Hand over** (included): repo, pipeline, documentation and a walkthrough, so the client can take
   it to any developer afterwards.

Fixed scope, fixed price, and a date in writing. Code ownership transfers to the client from day one.

## Pricing

Fixed price per project, quoted in the free scope call, in writing, with a date attached. No hourly
billing, and no retainer the client can't exit. Reduced founding-client rates apply to the next few
projects, in exchange for a case study and a reference.

A question that comes up often: if AI writes the code, why isn't it cheaper? The typing was never
the expensive part. The cost sits in deciding what to build, deciding what to leave out, and being
accountable when it breaks. The speed is the discount: weeks instead of months.
